concepts.name: Classic framed window
concepts.review: Complete readable interface; period controls, category navigation and personal ranking visible; sample scores labelled. Accepted as exploratory UI artwork.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop game leaderboard interface for Rabbit Lands, an established hand-painted fantasy MMORPG.
Primary request: create ONE complete, polished interface design image, wide landscape about 16:9, straight-on screen capture, large readable UI filling 90 percent of frame. This is a usable game-window mockup with carefully aligned real controls, not a promotional illustration, a website, a device photograph, a mood board, or a collage.
Input images: Image 1 is an existing Rabbit Lands heritage HUD style reference; Image 2 is an existing minimal HUD design reference. Use only to calibrate the game's warm fantasy identity, chunky painted icons, muted scenery, and good contrast. Do not copy their exact screen layout or chat text.
Established materials: matte charcoal stone #1E1E22, restrained warm brass #B88A3B and #F4C542, parchment #E9D5A8, oxblood #8E1B12, warm ivory text #F5F0E0. Exploration can reinterpret these materials to suit its direction.
Required interface identity text: "Rabbit Lands", "Leaderboards". Show clear category navigation, a "Search categories" field, and period controls "All time" and "Last 30 days", with All time selected. Only those two periods.
Category truth: 22 player categories exist. Progression/skills: Overall, Attack, Defense, Harvesting, Alchemy, Magic, Potion, Summoning, Manufacturing, Crafting, Engineering, Tailoring, Ranging. Activity: Invasion kills, Invasion boss kills, Instances completed, Ranging kills, Summoning kills, Magic kills, Harvests, Rare mixes, Rare stone finds. Group into collapsible sections if space requires. Keep a clear way to reach all 22, without squeezing tiny text everywhere.
Selected category: "Invasion kills". Header subtitle "Top 10 players". Table headers "Rank", "Player", "Kills". Sample rows in descending order: 1 Mira 8,420; 2 Rowan 7,965; 3 Tavi 6,218; 4 Nash 4,880; 5 Kellan (You) 3,108; 6 Ari 2,794; 7 Ilse 2,245; 8 Bren 1,930; 9 Sera 1,482; 10 Orin 1,120. Highlight Kellan's row clearly and show a personal summary "Your rank: 5" and "3,108 kills". Top three can have understated gold, silver, bronze rank marks. Use small consistent painted fantasy icons.
A tiny footer "Concept preview • Sample data" distinguishes invented sample scores. Clean close button top right. A muted sliver of the game's cobblestone courtyard can sit behind the window; the leaderboard itself is the focal point.
Typography: highly legible polished game UI typography, compact title serif and readable body sans serif, accurate verbatim labels, strong grid, generous row spacing, thoughtful negative space. Avoid illegible pseudo text, browser chrome, phones, neon, watermarks, reward claims, battle passes, invented currencies, trend arrows, seasons, ELO, paid controls, unrelated stats, or admin-only territory boards. This is an exploratory visual concept, not a shipped screenshot.

Direction 1 — CLASSIC FRAMED WINDOW. A refined version of Rabbit Lands' heritage UI, with restrained carved charcoal stone, fine double brass borders, warm ivory text, subtle burgundy active selections. A large centered rectangular window, left category sidebar about 24 percent width with the sections "Progression", "Skills", "Activity", selected Invasion kills under Activity. Main right area is a beautiful ten-row ranking table, compact trophy icon beside the heading, period switch at upper right. Table rows have understated alternating dark insets; gold, silver and bronze small rank medallions only in the first three. Kellan's fifth row has a thin gold outline and burgundy wash. Bottom inset strip shows the personal summary. Square-to-softly-rounded geometry; practical, coherent traditional MMORPG window. No extravagant scrollwork.

Direction 2 — PARCHMENT LEDGER. A bright, readable in-game journal UI occupying almost the whole screen, like an open two-page guild ledger rendered perfectly front-on, not a physical book photograph. Matte cream parchment pages, dark brown ink, restrained oxblood headers, very fine brass corner guards and a dark leather surround. LEFT PAGE: title and a tidy two-column category index of all 22 categories under clear sections, small painted skill icons, Invasion kills picked out with a burgundy bookmark tab. Elegant editorial hierarchy with plenty of whitespace; clean modern legibility inside a fantasy ledger motif. No decorative desk props, quill, hands, paper clutter, perspective angle, or obscuring illustration.

A sleek, highly usable floating game window with a translucent smoky charcoal backing, thin warm-brass hairlines, warm white type and restrained sage/teal accent for selection. Predominantly flat modern controls, minimal fantasy ornament, a little matte texture only in icons. Window in center at roughly 85 percent screen width and height, subtle courtyard visible at edges. TOP: title, subtitle, close control. Under it a horizontal navigation strip with "Overview", "Skills", "Activity"; Activity selected. A compact left side category list shows the nine activity boards and a search field, with an affordance "22 categories". The main region contains Invasion kills, pill-shaped All time / Last 30 days controls, ten airy rows, clean rank numbers, consistent player portrait circles and right-aligned kills. Treat every pixel as a real implementable interface; extremely disciplined spacing and strong contrast. No dashboard charts, heavy stone borders, or ornate fantasy framing.

Direction 5 — MULTI-CATEGORY OVERVIEW. A very distinct browsing-first game UI dashboard, warm cream and charcoal surfaces, restrained brass dividers, muted oxblood section headings, small hand-painted skill icons. The main content is a spacious two-by-two grid of leaderboard cards, not one giant table. Left sidebar gives search and the full category family navigation (Progression, Skills, Activity) with "22 categories". Global All time / Last 30 days segmented control at top. Four readable cards: "Overall" with headers Player and XP and rows Mira 12,840,000; Rowan 11,965,000; Tavi 10,218,000. "Invasion kills" with rows Mira 8,420; Rowan 7,965; Tavi 6,218; beneath, a subtle highlighted "You • #5 • 3,108 kills". "Harvests" with rows Ari 142,800; Ilse 126,400; Kellan (You) 118,200. "Instances completed" with rows Rowan 84; Mira 79; Nash 63. Each card has a small clear "View top 10" action and a descriptive category icon. A compact bottom strip shows the focused board "Invasion kills", "Your rank: 5", "3,108 kills". The card layout must stay roomy with readable numbers, not crowded or tiny. Include the title "Leaderboards" and small subheading "Explore the rankings". No graphs, invented stats or trend arrows. Clean fantasy editorial dashboard with strong grouping; visibly different from the other table-based directions.
